boundary: Privacy / Confidentiality alone would be unambiguous if the email carried only non-financial personal data; Financial / Assets would clearly be added if it sent payment credentials or moved/authorized funds rather than an account number and balance.
factor: disclosure of bank account details without any transaction
note: fact_layer correct and audit favours the single label; sets overlap on Privacy / Confidentiality and differ only in whether exposing an account number and balance is a second direct financial harm.
